title: The 4 Best Baby Bottles Under $15
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for baby bottles under $15, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at baby bottles under $15 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Comotomo Baby Bottle, Single Pack, 8oz
products.blurb: Key specs: 100% medical-grade silicone body, Wide neck for brushless hand washing, Dual anti-colic vents in the nipple collar.
strengths: Full anti-colic vent design in a single-bottle price point, no multi-pack commitment required
Soft silicone texture is a common reason babies who reject firmer nipples accept this one
Wide opening makes hand washing fast, useful when you only own 1 or 2 bottles to rotate
limitations: At single-bottle pricing you'll need to buy 2 or 3 separately to build a real rotation
Silicone shows fingerprints and grip marks faster than hard plastic
Wide barrel does not fit every bottle warmer
features: Wide neck for brushless hand washing
Dual anti-colic vents in the nipple collar

products.name: Dr. Brown's Options+ Narrow Glass Bottle, 8oz, 2-Pack
products.blurb: Key specs: Internal vent system that routes air away from milk, Borosilicate glass, BPA-free, Level 1 slow-flow nipple included.
strengths: Same internal vent system found in the pricier 4-pack, no anti-colic features cut for the smaller size
Glass resists odor and staining, a durability edge over budget plastic bottles
limitations: Most parts per bottle of any brand here, more to wash even at this smaller pack size
2 bottles isn't enough for a full day's rotation on its own
Glass is heavier and can chip if dropped
features: Internal vent system that routes air away from milk
Sold in a smaller 2-pack for a lower entry cost

products.name: Philips Avent Natural Baby Bottle, Clear, 4oz
products.blurb: Key specs: 4oz size, right-sized for newborn feeds, Wide, breast-shaped nipple, AirFree anti-colic valve.
strengths: Smallest, cheapest way to try the Avent Natural nipple shape before buying a 4-pack
4oz size matches newborn intake, no need to portion down from a bigger bottle
3-piece design keeps cleanup simple even with just 1 or 2 bottles in rotation
limitations: 1 bottle isn't enough for daily use without buying more
AirFree valve only vents fully when held mostly vertical
Per-bottle cost is higher than buying the 4-pack once you're ready to commit
features: Sold individually for a low entry cost

products.name: MAM Easy Start Anti-Colic Bottle 9 oz (3-Pack)
limitations: Nipple shape doesn't suit every baby
